picks.editorial_note: Purdue's role in over $42 million of NSF-funded national cyberinfrastructure grants underscores the scale of federal investment now flowing into AI- and data-driven research infrastructure that will underpin work across many institutions.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: A £5 million, government-backed trial using AI to steer flight paths away from climate-warming contrails is a rare case of AI research translating directly into a real-world climate policy intervention with a major industry partner (Google) and multiple universities.
picks.title: Operation Blue Skies takes off: landmark trial to test AI-driven contrail avoidance

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins' partnership with Toyota Research Institute pairs AI with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate battery materials discovery, a concrete example of AI-driven science with direct industrial application to energy storage.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: A five-year, industry-funded centre between Imperial College London and Smith+Nephew aims to translate academic computer-vision research directly into surgical robotics products, a significant academia-industry pipeline for medical AI.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: Tohoku University and Western Digital's new joint lab tackles a critical but under-covered bottleneck for AI progress: next-generation data storage infrastructure needed to sustain growing AI data demands.
picks.title: Tohoku University Launches AI Data Infrastructure Lab with Western Digital Corporation

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' in generative AI models has major implications for copyright, provenance, and accountability debates around AI-generated content, a genuine scientific finding with broad policy relevance.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: A Kent State researcher's selection for the U.S. Department of Energy's new Genesis Mission award to mine decades of water-quality data for critical minerals highlights a strategically important national initiative applying AI to resource security.
picks.title: Kent State Researcher Selected for US Department of Energy Genesis Mission Award to Mine Decades of River Data for Critical Minerals; Kent State Today; July 29, 2026

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's computational tools for the MOSAIC multi-modal microscope enable researchers to manage and interpret massive, complex datasets, a foundational scientific infrastructure advance for AI-assisted materials and biological imaging.
picks.title: Building the Computational Mind for the “Swiss Army Knife” of Microscopes

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Laboratory's integration of an agentic AI mission-debriefing tool into U.S. Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft operations marks a notable step of academic AI research moving into operational defense use.
picks.title: Human–AI mission debrief enters the Air Force through ARCADE

picks.editorial_note: Purdue becoming one of the first universities nationally to require AI competency coursework in every undergraduate degree program signals a significant shift in how higher education is institutionalizing AI literacy.
picks.title: Purdue’s AI competency graduation requirement begins in every undergraduate degree program
